theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_bl_db_weight_le_enorm
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ζx ζa : MultiVector P n) (t t₀ C : ℝ), 0 ≤ t₀ → 0 ≤ C → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ‖α‖ ≤ C * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ζa α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζx β = 1) → ENNReal.ofReal t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal t₀ + ENNReal.ofReal C * ‖t • ζx - t₀ • ζa‖ₑ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
